t: This is a shop of OKA, a British furniture and home accessories retailer. It was founded in 1999 by Annabel Astor, Sue Jones and Lucinda Waterhouse. Astor, Viscountess Astor, is an English businesswoman and socialite, and a former chief executive of the company. Before OKA she owned and designed the Annabel Jones jewellery business in London. OKA now has fourteen shops across the UK, plus websites and a catalogue business, and is owned by Investindustrial.
